items.question: What does an appointed village engineer do?
items.answer: A village engineer acts as the community's engineering department. That usually includes reviewing development plans against local codes, managing capital projects, advising the board and staff on infrastructure, and overseeing construction of public improvements.

items.question: Can you help on a single project instead of an ongoing role?
items.answer: Yes. We serve some communities as appointed engineer and others project by project, from a single street program to a sewer system evaluation.

items.question: Do you help with Motor Fuel Tax street programs?
items.answer: Yes. We help communities plan and deliver annual maintenance and road improvement programs, including work funded through Illinois Motor Fuel Tax.
